motif: A single Brasa-orange ember glow leaking from a dark soot-black mouth or vent, with a crooked lashed drill-pipe stack above it. Every building has one glowing opening and one crooked pipe.

buildings.why: Fighters' Hall chain. It adds a hide loft with its own furnace stack, so it is the middle step.
Derrick-mast trellis with a crooked diagonal. It is the race's one pure tall tower.
Shamanic Tent chain. The upturned-cauldron belly is a round dome, and the dark mouth is the door.
Skull-hung pipe mast ending in a brazier ring. The hollow crown keeps it apart from the tower and the spired totems.
Kodo Farm chain. A boiler-lid roof-plate on tall posts over the pen is a taller, open gate, and the drum-tower adds height.

buildings.archetype: spired cluster of two or three peaks
buildings.why: Legendary Totem chain. The bellows post grows from the three-mask mast, with spokes of pipe.
A high falconry platform over a pipe mast. The fire-basket makes it the race's tall burning mark.
Fighters' Hall chain base. A crooked layered hide roof with a central vent; the chain grows upward by tiers.
Troll Hut chain, which keeps its stacked-barrel build. The well-mouth pit and bark-and-net roof sit low in the stack.

buildings.archetype: spired cluster of two or three peaks
buildings.why: Legendary Totem chain. A drum base and cauldron with a steam plume form a short peak cluster.
Shamanic Tent chain. Captured-cloth walls under one wide dented stovepipe horn.
The burnt derrick arch over the pen is the gate, with stakes and drums in the corners.

buildings.archetype: spired cluster of two or three peaks
buildings.why: A bare pipe mast with three empty sockets and three masks on hooks. It reads as three peaks waiting to be chosen.
Kodo Farm chain. A reinforced fence with torn standards, split by the broken conduit trough.
An open dismantling shed with a derrick traction wheel as a side crane.
A melted, twisted zigzag of pipe leans from the rock into a mouth.
The lowest, widest rib-lattice tent of the race. The brazier shows through the mouth.
Kodo Farm chain. One hunched, asymmetric quilt arcs over the whole pen, in contrast to h036's open roof-plate.

buildings.archetype: spired cluster of two or three peaks
buildings.why: Legendary Totem chain. A lopsided drum and horn shell cluster over a pressure coil, with steam rings.

buildings.colour: deep red painted panels with ivory tusks
buildings.why: Fighters' Hall chain. It is the largest tiered hall, with a jaw-gate of tusks and a heart-forge.
Troll Hut chain. The hut straddles the killed pump, and the well-head breaks through the floor as the porch.
A chimney of piled burned-out barrels, with fire glowing in the skull mouth at the base.
